draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.30, the 59th-best grade among 257 2025 draftees and 2nd of 13 at QB. He lasted until pick 144, well after his grade rank (59th): he slid relative to the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 4,134 passing yards in 2024, 4th of 13 QBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 2 pro, currently with the Cleveland Browns. 8 career games and 7 starts over 1 completed season, plus 1 so far in 2026. Still developing: 2 AV in 2025. Weak spots: approximate value 2 (6th percentile), epa per dropback -0.25 (6th percentile). Played 8 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-1 quarterback who played: 1,400 passing yards against a median of 1,341, above the norm.
